QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Tour of Town Square
QuestInfo.0: Alvin wants to give you a tour of the Town Square. You should speak with him.
QuestInfo.1: Alvin wants to give you a tour of the Town Square. You should speak with him.
QuestInfo.2:
While taking a tour of the town square with Alvin, you had a chance to meet some of your new neighbors.


Miranda told you that she sells home furnishings from time to time, and Ethan told you he runs a woodworking shop, but isn't confident enough in his craft just yet to sell his creations. You also met a cute little girl named Trudy and her cat, who is aptly named 'Kitty.'

default.0: Visit Town Square using the door to the left.
